<?php

$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$parts = explode(' ', $input);
$l = (int)$parts[0];
$r = (int)$parts[1];

$w = [];
$W = [];
$q = 0;
$Q = 0;

while ($l > 0) {
    $w[$q++] = $l & 1;
    $l >>= 1;
}

while ($r > 0) {
    $W[$Q++] = $r & 1;
    $r >>= 1;
}

$p = 0;
$maxLen = max($q, $Q);

for ($i = $maxLen; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $bitL = $w[$i] ?? 0;
    $bitR = $W[$i] ?? 0;
    if ($bitL != $bitR) {
        $p = $i + 1;
        break;
    }
}

$ans = (1 << $p) - 1;
echo $ans;

<?php
$input = fgets(STDIN);
$parts = explode(' ', trim($input));
$l = (int)$parts[0];
$r = (int)$parts[1];

$w = [];
$W = [];
$q = 0;
$Q = 0;
$p = 0;

while ($l) {
    $w[$q++] = $l & 1;
    $l >>= 1;
}
while ($r) {
    $W[$Q++] = $r & 1;
    $r >>= 1;
}

for ($i = $Q; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    if (($w[$i] ?? 0) != ($W[$i] ?? 0)) {
        $p = $i + 1;
        break;
    }
}

$ans = (1 << $p) - 1;
echo $ans;
?>

Let's consider the values of  for all pairs of integers a and b (l ≤ a ≤ b ≤ r). Your task is to find the maximum value among all considered ones.Expression  means applying bitwise excluding or operation to integers x and y. The given operation exists in all modern programming languages, for example, in languages C++ and Java it is represented as "^", in Pascal — as "xor".
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: In a single line print a single integer — the maximum value of  for all pairs of integers a, b (l ≤ a ≤ b ≤ r).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The single line contains space-separated integers l and r (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 1018). Please, do not use the %lld specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in C++. It is preferred to use the cin, cout streams or the %I64d specifier.
